methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Seed → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.5x) to $6M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Albacore is a Seed-stage company in the Ocean & Maritime sector founded by John Huddleston and Dante Vaisbort, having raised $6.5M to date. The valuation universe consists of three private comparables—Standard Subsea, Clippership, and NetworkOcean—with no publicly traded peers available for direct benchmarking.

The Stage-Progression method applies a 2.5x multiplier to the $6M raised proxy, reflecting typical valuation step-ups from Seed to the subsequent funding round. This method yields an implied valuation of $16M. Given the limited comp set and single applicable methodology, the triangulated range sits at $14M (low), $16M (median), and $19M (high). The median represents the most defensible estimate under standard Seed-stage progression assumptions.

The primary valuation uncertainty stems from reliance on a single method and an opaque private comp universe. Without public market anchors or detailed financials on the three private peers, the analysis cannot validate whether the 2.5x multiplier is appropriate for Albacore's specific risk profile or market traction. The range of $14M–$19M should be treated as a preliminary indication pending fuller disclosure of comparable company metrics and Albacore's own operational metrics.
